_comment: NON-RUNNABLE INSTALLATION TEMPLATE for Kimi Code hooks. deploy/register-members.py renders it into ~/.kimi-code/config.toml as flat `[[hooks]] event = ...` tables (install.registration.layout = flat), adding only what is missing by target basename. Unrendered placeholders must never be deployed.
_witness_note: witness.py is the hook that reaches the daemon; kimi fires PostToolUseFailure INSTEAD of PostToolUse for a failed call, so the witness is registered on both. Before 2026-09-28 kimi shipped no witness: its seat ran a private 07-26 copy of claude-code's that never saw a failure and never closed a gated action (findings/per-harness-witness-drift-2026-09-28.md).
_timeout_contract: One-gate stage C. The PreToolUse gate READS its timeout from the flat [[hooks]] table this template becomes (seconds; an entry without one is refused, since Kimi's default is not documented here) and decides inside start + timeout - 1.5 s, so it always fails closed before Kimi kills it (Kimi's engine allows the tool on a timeout, i.e. fail-open). 15 s absorbs a cold member connect (measured 4.6-5.1 s). Nothing in this template sets HESTIA_PRE_TOTAL_BUDGET_MS: since stage C no gate reads it (the deadline is the registration's), so a hand-added one on a registered command is inert and should be removed.
